# FLX-3504: a sink was given a target or an option it cannot use

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A sink writes only where it is told to and only in ways it can name, so it checks its target and its options before it opens: a file sink needs a directory that is not a file, a stream whose expose id is a safe single path segment, and options of the right type and range; every sink needs to be opened on the stream it was set up for. The message names the target or the option and says what it expects. Nothing was written.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3504
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
